reference_character.scale_rule: Treat the 60.5 px Juno south idle as an approximately 171 cm adult reference. Architectural vertical dimensions are derived from real-world ratios, not from the 32 px construction footprint.

real_world_architecture.notes: 72 px door follows the approximately 2.03 m residential door / 1.71 m adult ratio. 88 px wall follows an approximately 2.44 m habitable ceiling reference while leaving about 16 px of header/wall above the door.

grids.rule: One construction cell equals a 2x2 block of Romestead-style terrain subtiles. Visual sprites may extend above the footprint but collision and placement remain on the 32 px construction grid.

run_rendering.horizontal: Merge contiguous east-west wall-family cells into one repeated/tiled horizontal strip.
run_rendering.vertical: Merge contiguous north-south wall-family cells into one repeated/tiled vertical strip.
run_rendering.junctions: Overlay wall_joint_post where horizontal and vertical runs meet and at visually exposed endpoints.
run_rendering.special_segments: Window and doorway cells split the run locally and insert their orientation-specific module.

special_segment_rules.window: Must belong to a straight wall axis.
special_segment_rules.doorway: Must belong to a straight wall axis. Door leaf is attached to the doorway.
special_segment_rules.door: Opening state changes leaf collision/navigation only. The structural doorway remains part of room topology.

interior_readability.rule: Only player-built walls between camera and player are faded when the player is inside a detected construction room. Existing authored roof/occlusion systems remain untouched.
interior_readability.future_roof: Roof coverage continues to be room-group based and may reuse the existing roof disappearance system.

runtime_implications: Save orientation, material skin, wall-family subtype and attachment state per construction cell.
Rebuild only dirty wall runs after placement/removal.
Door state updates collision/navigation but does not break semantic room enclosure.
Closed wall loops create semantic indoor regions.
Construction cutaway is additive to existing authored-world roof/occlusion logic and is restricted to player-built structures.
Upper-floor surfaces continue using MultiFloorBuildManager while stairs migrate to oriented 1x2/2x1 footprints.
